figurative_meaning_en: indicating a sudden or unexpected appearance
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হুপ করে এসে সবাইকে অবাক করে দিল।
বৃষ্টির মধ্যে হুপ করে একটা রংধনু দেখা গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He appeared out of nowhere and surprised everyone.
A rainbow popped up suddenly in the middle of the rain.
history: References Hanuman from the Ramayana epic, who is said to have leaped across the ocean to Lanka in a single bound, symbolizing swift and sudden arrival.
note: The idiom draws from Hindu mythology, commonly used in Bengali folklore and everyday speech to denote abrupt presence.
